title: Enterprise Management Incentives (EMI) and Enterprise Management Incentives 2 (EMI2)
text: Enterprise Management Incentives (EMI) and Enterprise Management Incentives 2 (EMI2) (previously known as CSOP) are tax-advantaged share schemes. They allow eligible companies to give employees the option to buy shares in the future at an agreed price when the option is granted.
